def plot_regime_transitions(
    equity_or_scenarios: BacktestResult | pd.Series | ScenarioMarketData,
    gmm_or_probs: GMMRegimeGenerator | pd.DataFrame | np.ndarray | None = None,
    market_data: MarketData | None = None,
    asset_weights: np.ndarray | pd.Series | None = None,
    theme: ThemeName | str = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Macro Regime Transition Overlay & State Probabilities",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Plots the portfolio equity curve against the real-time probability (p_k) of operating
    in each Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) macro regime (e.g., Bull/Low-Vol vs. Bear/High-Vol).
    Supports both:
    - Historical Mode (`BacktestResult` or `pd.Series` + `GMMRegimeGenerator` or regime probability DataFrame)
    - Synthetic Multiverse Mode (`ScenarioMarketData` with `features['regime_states']`)
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)
    regime_colors = [
        palette.emerald,
        palette.amber,
        palette.crimson,
        palette.violet,
        palette.cyan,
    ]

    # Case 1: Synthetic Multiverse ScenarioMarketData
    if isinstance(equity_or_scenarios, ScenarioMarketData):
        scen = equity_or_scenarios
        equity_paths, timestamps = extract_equity_paths(
            scen, asset_weights=asset_weights
        )
        x_vals = list(timestamps)
        M, T = equity_paths.shape

        if "regime_states" in scen.features:
            states_sim = scen.features["regime_states"][:, :, 0].astype(int)  # (M, T)
            unique_regimes = sorted(np.unique(states_sim).tolist())
            k_eff = max(len(unique_regimes), int(np.max(states_sim)) + 1)
            probs_arr = np.zeros((T, k_eff), dtype=np.float64)
            for k in range(k_eff):
                probs_arr[:, k] = np.mean(states_sim == k, axis=0)
            labels = (
                gmm_or_probs.regime_labels
                if isinstance(gmm_or_probs, GMMRegimeGenerator)
                and gmm_or_probs.regime_labels
                else [
                    "Bull / Low-Vol"
                    if k == 0
                    else ("Bear / High-Vol" if k == k_eff - 1 else f"Regime {k}")
                    for k in range(k_eff)
                ]
            )
            regime_probs_df = pd.DataFrame(probs_arr, index=timestamps, columns=labels)
        elif isinstance(gmm_or_probs, pd.DataFrame):
            regime_probs_df = gmm_or_probs
        else:
            raise ValueError(
                "ScenarioMarketData does not contain 'regime_states' in features; pass a fitted GMMRegimeGenerator or regime probabilities."
            )

        fig = make_subplots(
            rows=2,
            cols=1,
            shared_xaxes=True,
            row_heights=[0.62, 0.38],
            vertical_spacing=0.07,
            subplot_titles=(
                "Simulated Equity Trajectory (Median & 10th–90th Cone)",
                "Cross-Sectional Regime Probability p_k(t) Across Synthetic Paths",
            ),
        )

        q10, q50, q90 = weighted_quantiles(equity_paths, [0.10, 0.50, 0.90])
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals, y=q90, mode="lines", line={"width": 0}, showlegend=False
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals,
                y=q10,
                mode="lines",
                line={"width": 0},
                fill="tonexty",
                fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(palette.cyan, 0.22),
                name="10th–90th Equity Cone",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals,
                y=q50,
                mode="lines",
                line={"color": palette.cyan, "width": 2.8},
                name="Median Portfolio Equity",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )

        for idx, col in enumerate(regime_probs_df.columns):
            c_hex = regime_colors[idx % len(regime_colors)]
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(
                    x=x_vals,
                    y=regime_probs_df[col],
                    mode="lines",
                    stackgroup="regimes",
                    line={"color": c_hex, "width": 1.2},
                    fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(c_hex, 0.55),
                    name=str(col),
                    hovertemplate=f"{col}: %{{y:.1%}}<extra></extra>",
                ),
                row=2,
                col=1,
            )

        apply_plotly_theme(
            fig,
            theme=theme,
            title=title,
            subtitle=f"Dynamic Markov regime proportions across {M:,} simulated paths",
            height=580,
        )
        fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Portfolio Equity", row=1, col=1)
        fig.update_yaxes(
            title_text="Regime Prob p_k(t)",
            tickformat=".0%",
            range=[0, 1],
            row=2,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Simulation Horizon", row=2, col=1)
        return fig

    # Case 2: Historical BacktestResult or Equity Series
    equity_series = (
        equity_or_scenarios.equity_curve
        if isinstance(equity_or_scenarios, BacktestResult)
        else pd.Series(equity_or_scenarios)
    )

    if isinstance(gmm_or_probs, GMMRegimeGenerator):
        if market_data is not None:
            regime_probs_df = gmm_or_probs.predict_regime_probs(market_data)
        elif gmm_or_probs.historical_regime_probs is not None:
            regime_probs_df = gmm_or_probs.historical_regime_probs
        else:
            raise ValueError(
                "GMMRegimeGenerator must be fitted or `market_data` provided."
            )
    elif isinstance(gmm_or_probs, pd.DataFrame):
        regime_probs_df = gmm_or_probs
    elif isinstance(gmm_or_probs, np.ndarray):
        gmm_or_probs.shape[1] if gmm_or_probs.ndim == 2 else 1
        probs_2d = (
            gmm_or_probs
            if gmm_or_probs.ndim == 2
            else np.column_stack([1.0 - gmm_or_probs, gmm_or_probs])
        )
        regime_probs_df = pd.DataFrame(
            probs_2d,
            index=equity_series.index[: len(probs_2d)],
            columns=[f"Regime {k}" for k in range(probs_2d.shape[1])],
        )
    else:
        raise TypeError(
            "Provide `gmm_or_probs` as a fitted `GMMRegimeGenerator`, DataFrame, or 2D array."
        )

    common_idx = equity_series.index.intersection(regime_probs_df.index)
    if len(common_idx) == 0:
        # Align by position if indices differ in type
        min_len = min(len(equity_series), len(regime_probs_df))
        eq_aligned = equity_series.iloc[-min_len:]
        probs_aligned = regime_probs_df.iloc[-min_len:].set_index(eq_aligned.index)
    else:
        eq_aligned = equity_series.loc[common_idx]
        probs_aligned = regime_probs_df.loc[common_idx]

    x_vals = list(eq_aligned.index)
    dominant_regime = np.argmax(probs_aligned.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64), axis=1)

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=2,
        cols=1,
        shared_xaxes=True,
        row_heights=[0.62, 0.38],
        vertical_spacing=0.07,
        subplot_titles=(
            "Portfolio Equity Curve with Dominant Macro Regime Shading",
            "Real-Time Posterior Regime Probabilities p_k(t)",
        ),
    )

    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=x_vals,
            y=eq_aligned.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
            mode="lines",
            line={"color": palette.text_primary, "width": 2.6},
            name="Portfolio Equity",
            hovertemplate="Equity: %{y:.4f}<extra></extra>",
        ),
        row=1,
        col=1,
    )

    # Shade contiguous dominant regime segments on the top equity chart
    if len(x_vals) > 1:
        seg_start = 0
        for t in range(1, len(x_vals) + 1):
            if t == len(x_vals) or dominant_regime[t] != dominant_regime[seg_start]:
                reg_id = int(dominant_regime[seg_start])
                c_hex = regime_colors[reg_id % len(regime_colors)]
                x0 = x_vals[seg_start]
                x1 = x_vals[min(t, len(x_vals) - 1)]
                fig.add_vrect(
                    x0=x0,
                    x1=x1,
                    fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(c_hex, 0.16),
                    line_width=0,
                    layer="below",
                    row=1,
                    col=1,
                )
                seg_start = t

    # Bottom panel: Stacked area chart of real-time regime probabilities p_k(t)
    for idx, col in enumerate(probs_aligned.columns):
        c_hex = regime_colors[idx % len(regime_colors)]
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals,
                y=probs_aligned[col].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                mode="lines",
                stackgroup="prob_stack",
                line={"color": c_hex, "width": 1.2},
                fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(c_hex, 0.55),
                name=str(col),
                hovertemplate=f"{col}: %{{y:.1%}}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=2,
            col=1,
        )

    regime_shares = probs_aligned.mean(axis=0)
    share_str = " | ".join(f"{col}: {val:.1%}" for col, val in regime_shares.items())

    apply_plotly_theme(
        fig,
        theme=theme,
        title=title,
        subtitle=f"Average Regime Occupancy — {share_str}",
        height=580,
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Cumulative Equity", row=1, col=1)
    fig.update_yaxes(
        title_text="Probability p_k(t)", tickformat=".0%", range=[0, 1], row=2, col=1
    )
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Date", row=2, col=1)
    return fig

plot_multi_universe_frontier(
    expected_returns: Series | ndarray | None = None,
    cov_matrix: DataFrame | ndarray | None = None,
    scenario_data: ScenarioMarketData | None = None,
    allocator_or_pipeline: BaseAllocator
    | StrategyPipeline

) -> go.Figure

Renders a risk/return scatter plot combining: 1. The parametric Markowitz Efficient Frontier curve (and individual asset coordinates). 2. A Random Dirichlet Portfolio Cloud colored by Sharpe ratio. 3. A Multi-Universe Optimal Allocation Cloud generated across synthetic realities (ScenarioMarketData + allocator_or_pipeline or precomputed optimal_portfolios).

Source code in src/pyalloq-viz/src/pyalloq_viz/allocation.py 
def plot_multi_universe_frontier(
    expected_returns: pd.Series | np.ndarray | None = None,
    cov_matrix: pd.DataFrame | np.ndarray | None = None,
    scenario_data: ScenarioMarketData | None = None,
    allocator_or_pipeline: BaseAllocator | StrategyPipeline | None = None,
    optimal_portfolios: OptimizationResult
    | Sequence[OptimizationResult]
    | pd.DataFrame
    | None = None,
    n_random_portfolios: int = 400,
    max_scenario_solves: int = 80,
    risk_free_rate: float = 0.0,
    theme: ThemeName | str = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Multi-Universe Efficient Frontier & Optimal Allocation Cloud",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Renders a risk/return scatter plot combining:
    1. The parametric Markowitz Efficient Frontier curve (and individual asset coordinates).
    2. A Random Dirichlet Portfolio Cloud colored by Sharpe ratio.
    3. A Multi-Universe Optimal Allocation Cloud generated across synthetic realities
       (`ScenarioMarketData` + `allocator_or_pipeline` or precomputed `optimal_portfolios`).
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)
    ann_factor = 252.0

    # Infer expected_returns and cov_matrix from scenario_data if not directly provided
    asset_names: list[str] = []
    if cov_matrix is not None:
        if isinstance(cov_matrix, pd.DataFrame):
            asset_names = [str(c) for c in cov_matrix.columns]
            Sigma = cov_matrix.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
        else:
            Sigma = np.asarray(cov_matrix, dtype=np.float64)
            asset_names = [f"Asset_{i}" for i in range(Sigma.shape[0])]
    elif scenario_data is not None:
        asset_names = list(scenario_data.asset_names)
        mean_path_rets = np.mean(
            scenario_data.returns.astype(np.float64), axis=0
        )  # (T, N)
        Sigma = np.cov(mean_path_rets, rowvar=False) * ann_factor
    else:
        raise ValueError(
            "Provide `cov_matrix` or `scenario_data` to plot the Efficient Frontier."
        )

    N = Sigma.shape[0]
    if expected_returns is not None:
        if isinstance(expected_returns, pd.Series):
            mu = (
                expected_returns.reindex(asset_names)
                .fillna(0.0)
                .to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
            )
        else:
            mu = np.asarray(expected_returns, dtype=np.float64)
    elif scenario_data is not None:
        mu = np.mean(scenario_data.returns.astype(np.float64), axis=(0, 1)) * ann_factor
    else:
        mu = np.sqrt(np.diag(Sigma)) * 0.6

    fig = go.Figure()

    # 1. Random Dirichlet Portfolio Cloud
    if n_random_portfolios > 0 and N >= 2:
        rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
        rand_w = rng.dirichlet(np.ones(N), size=n_random_portfolios)
        rand_rets = rand_w @ mu
        rand_vols = np.sqrt(np.einsum("mi,ij,mj->m", rand_w, Sigma, rand_w))
        rand_sharpes = (rand_rets - risk_free_rate) / np.maximum(rand_vols, 1e-12)

        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=rand_vols,
                y=rand_rets,
                mode="markers",
                marker={
                    "size": 6,
                    "color": rand_sharpes,
                    "colorscale": "Tealgrn",
                    "opacity": 0.45,
                    "colorbar": {"title": "Sharpe", "thickness": 12, "len": 0.65},
                },
                name="Random Feasible Portfolios",
                hovertemplate="Vol: %{x:.2%}<br>Return: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>",
            )
        )

    # 2. Parametric Markowitz Efficient Frontier Curve
    if N >= 2:
        f_vols, f_rets, _ = _solve_parametric_frontier(mu, Sigma, n_points=35)
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=f_vols,
                y=f_rets,
                mode="lines",
                line={"color": palette.emerald, "width": 3},
                name="Parametric Efficient Frontier",
                hovertemplate="Frontier Vol: %{x:.2%}<br>Frontier Return: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>",
            )
        )

    # 3. Individual Assets
    asset_vols = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(Sigma), 0.0))
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=asset_vols,
            y=mu,
            mode="markers+text",
            text=asset_names,
            textposition="top center",
            textfont={"size": 10, "color": palette.text_secondary},
            marker={
                "size": 10,
                "symbol": "diamond",
                "color": palette.cyan,
                "line": {"width": 1.5, "color": palette.bg_primary},
            },
            name="Individual Assets",
            hovertemplate="<b>%{text}</b><br>Vol: %{x:.2%}<br>Expected Return: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>",
        )
    )

    # 4. Multi-Universe Optimal Allocation Cloud across Synthetic Realities
    sim_vols: list[float] = []
    sim_rets: list[float] = []

    if scenario_data is not None:
        M_paths = min(scenario_data.n_paths, max_scenario_solves)
        for m in range(M_paths):
            path_rets = scenario_data.returns[m].astype(np.float64)  # (T, N)
            mu_m = np.mean(path_rets, axis=0) * ann_factor
            cov_m = np.cov(path_rets, rowvar=False) * ann_factor
            if cov_m.ndim == 0:
                cov_m = np.array([[float(cov_m)]])

            w_m: np.ndarray | None = None
            if isinstance(allocator_or_pipeline, StrategyPipeline):
                path_md = scenario_data.get_path(m)
                w_ser = allocator_or_pipeline.generate_weights(path_md)
                w_m = w_ser.reindex(asset_names).fillna(0.0).to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
            elif isinstance(allocator_or_pipeline, BaseAllocator):
                path_md = scenario_data.get_path(m)
                cov_df = pd.DataFrame(cov_m, index=asset_names, columns=asset_names)
                mu_ser = pd.Series(mu_m, index=asset_names)
                try:
                    opt_res = allocator_or_pipeline.allocate(
                        data=path_md, cov_matrix=cov_df, expected_returns=mu_ser
                    )
                    w_m = (
                        opt_res.weights.reindex(asset_names)
                        .fillna(0.0)
                        .to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
                    )
                except (ValueError, RuntimeError, np.linalg.LinAlgError):
                    w_m = None
            else:
                # Default: compute min-variance / tangency allocation on scenario m
                inv_diag = 1.0 / np.maximum(np.diag(cov_m), 1e-8)
                w_m = inv_diag / np.sum(inv_diag)

            if w_m is not None and np.sum(w_m) > 0:
                w_m = w_m / np.sum(w_m)
                # Plot scenario-optimal portfolio evaluated under scenario m's realized dynamics
                sim_vols.append(float(np.sqrt(max(float(w_m.T @ cov_m @ w_m), 0.0))))
                sim_rets.append(float(w_m @ mu_m))

    if len(sim_vols) > 0:
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=sim_vols,
                y=sim_rets,
                mode="markers",
                marker={
                    "size": 9,
                    "color": palette.violet,
                    "opacity": 0.82,
                    "symbol": "circle",
                    "line": {"width": 1, "color": palette.text_primary},
                },
                name=f"Multi-Universe Optimal Cloud ({len(sim_vols)} Realities)",
                hovertemplate="Scenario Optimal Vol: %{x:.2%}<br>Scenario Optimal Return: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>",
            )
        )

    # 5. Highlighted Optimal Portfolio(s)
    if optimal_portfolios is not None:
        opt_list: list[tuple[str, np.ndarray]] = []
        if isinstance(optimal_portfolios, OptimizationResult):
            w_arr = (
                optimal_portfolios.weights.reindex(asset_names)
                .fillna(0.0)
                .to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
            )
            opt_list.append(
                (str(getattr(optimal_portfolios, "status", "Optimal Portfolio")), w_arr)
            )
        elif isinstance(optimal_portfolios, pd.DataFrame):
            for idx_name, row in optimal_portfolios.iterrows():
                opt_list.append(
                    (
                        str(idx_name),
                        row.reindex(asset_names).fillna(0.0).to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                    )
                )
        else:
            for i, opt in enumerate(optimal_portfolios):
                w_arr = (
                    opt.weights.reindex(asset_names)
                    .fillna(0.0)
                    .to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
                )
                opt_list.append((f"{opt.status} ({i + 1})", w_arr))

        for label, w_arr in opt_list:
            p_vol = float(np.sqrt(max(float(w_arr.T @ Sigma @ w_arr), 0.0)))
            p_ret = float(w_arr @ mu)
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(
                    x=[p_vol],
                    y=[p_ret],
                    mode="markers",
                    marker={
                        "size": 15,
                        "symbol": "star",
                        "color": palette.amber,
                        "line": {"width": 1.5, "color": palette.bg_primary},
                    },
                    name=label,
                    hovertemplate=f"<b>{label}</b><br>Vol: %{{x:.2%}}<br>Return: %{{y:.2%}}<extra></extra>",
                )
            )

    subtitle = f"Universe of {N} assets"
    if len(sim_vols) > 0:
        subtitle += f" | {len(sim_vols)} synthetic optimal allocations rendered"

    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, subtitle=subtitle, height=540)
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Annualized Volatility (σ)", tickformat=".1%")
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Annualized Expected Return (μ)", tickformat=".1%")
    return fig

def plot_weight_drift_turnover(
    backtest_result: BacktestResult | pd.DataFrame,
    market_data: MarketData | pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    theme: ThemeName | str = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Asset Weight Drift & Rebalance Turnover Dynamics",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Plots a two-panel view of portfolio allocation mechanics over time:
    - Top Panel: Stacked area chart of asset weights drifting naturally due to daily
      market movements and snapping back during rebalancing events.
    - Bottom Panel: Bar chart of two-way portfolio turnover at each rebalance event
      alongside cumulative turnover.
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)
    drifted_df, turnover_series = reconstruct_drifted_weights(
        backtest_result, market_data=market_data
    )

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=2,
        cols=1,
        shared_xaxes=True,
        row_heights=[0.66, 0.34],
        vertical_spacing=0.07,
        subplot_titles=(
            "Drifted Asset Weights & Rebalance Snap-Backs",
            "Rebalance Two-Way Turnover (∑ |Δw_i|)",
        ),
    )

    x_vals = list(drifted_df.index)
    for idx, asset in enumerate(drifted_df.columns):
        c_hex = palette.categorical[idx % len(palette.categorical)]
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals,
                y=drifted_df[asset].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                mode="lines",
                stackgroup="weights",
                line={"color": c_hex, "width": 1.0},
                fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(c_hex, 0.72),
                name=str(asset),
                hovertemplate=f"<b>{asset}</b>: %{{y:.2%}}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )

    # Filter non-zero rebalance events for cleaner bar chart rendering
    reb_events = turnover_series[turnover_series > 1e-5]
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Bar(
            x=list(reb_events.index),
            y=reb_events.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
            marker={
                "color": palette.amber,
                "line": {"color": palette.amber, "width": 1},
            },
            name="Rebalance Turnover",
            hovertemplate="Date: %{x}<br>Turnover: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>",
        ),
        row=2,
        col=1,
    )

    total_turnover = (
        float(turnover_series.iloc[1:].sum()) if len(turnover_series) > 1 else 0.0
    )
    n_rebalances = (
        int((turnover_series.iloc[1:] > 1e-5).sum()) if len(turnover_series) > 1 else 0
    )

    subtitle = (
        f"Rebalance Events: {n_rebalances} | "
        f"Cumulative Post-Init Turnover: {total_turnover:.1%} | "
        f"Avg Turnover / Rebalance: {(total_turnover / max(1, n_rebalances)):.2%}"
    )

    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, subtitle=subtitle, height=580)
    fig.update_yaxes(
        title_text="Portfolio Weight", tickformat=".0%", range=[0.0, 1.0], row=1, col=1
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Turnover (%)", tickformat=".0%", row=2, col=1)
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Date", row=2, col=1)
    return fig

def plot_hierarchical_composition(
    weights_or_result: OptimizationResult | pd.Series,
    target_or_benchmark_weights: OptimizationResult | pd.Series | None = None,
    hierarchy: Mapping[str, str | Sequence[str]] | pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    market_data: MarketData | None = None,
    theme: ThemeName | str = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Hierarchical Portfolio Composition & Target vs. Current Allocation",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Left Panel: Multi-level Treemap displaying hierarchical portfolio structure
      (e.g., Portfolio -> Sector/Cluster -> Asset), resolving hierarchy from explicit
      `hierarchy` mapping, `MarketData.cross_sectional`, `OptimizationResult.metadata['clusters']`,
      or flat fallback.
    Right Panel: Grouped horizontal comparison bar chart of Current/Optimized vs. Target/Benchmark weights.
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)

    if isinstance(weights_or_result, OptimizationResult):
        w_series = weights_or_result.weights.copy()
        meta_clusters = weights_or_result.metadata.get("clusters")
    else:
        w_series = pd.Series(weights_or_result).copy()
        meta_clusters = None

    w_series = w_series[w_series > 1e-6]
    assets = [str(a) for a in w_series.index]

    # Resolve parent group for each asset
    parent_map: dict[str, str] = {}
    if isinstance(hierarchy, pd.DataFrame):
        col = hierarchy.columns[0]
        for a in assets:
            if a in hierarchy.index:
                parent_map[a] = str(hierarchy.loc[a, col])
    elif isinstance(hierarchy, Mapping):
        for k, v in hierarchy.items():
            if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) and not isinstance(v, str):
                parent_map[str(k)] = " / ".join(str(x) for x in v)
            else:
                parent_map[str(k)] = str(v)
    elif (
        market_data is not None
        and market_data.cross_sectional is not None
        and not market_data.cross_sectional.empty
    ):
        cs = market_data.cross_sectional
        sector_col = next(
            (
                c
                for c in cs.columns
                if "sector" in str(c).lower()
                or "group" in str(c).lower()
                or "class" in str(c).lower()
            ),
            cs.columns[0],
        )
        for a in assets:
            if a in cs.index:
                parent_map[a] = str(cs.loc[a, sector_col])
    elif isinstance(meta_clusters, Mapping):
        for a in assets:
            if a in meta_clusters:
                parent_map[a] = str(meta_clusters[a])

    # Build Treemap nodes (Root -> Group -> Asset)
    root_label = "Portfolio"
    ids: list[str] = [root_label]
    labels: list[str] = [root_label]
    parents: list[str] = [""]
    values: list[float] = [float(w_series.sum())]

    if parent_map:
        group_totals: dict[str, float] = {}
        for k_asset, val in w_series.items():
            g = parent_map.get(str(k_asset), "Other")
            group_totals[g] = group_totals.get(g, 0.0) + float(val)

        for g, g_val in group_totals.items():
            g_id = f"{root_label}/{g}"
            ids.append(g_id)
            labels.append(g)
            parents.append(root_label)
            values.append(g_val)

        for k_asset, val in w_series.items():
            a_str = str(k_asset)
            g = parent_map.get(a_str, "Other")
            g_id = f"{root_label}/{g}"
            ids.append(f"{g_id}/{a_str}")
            labels.append(a_str)
            parents.append(g_id)
            values.append(float(val))
    else:
        for k_asset, val in w_series.items():
            a_str = str(k_asset)
            ids.append(f"{root_label}/{a_str}")
            labels.append(a_str)
            parents.append(root_label)
            values.append(float(val))

    # Resolve target / benchmark comparison weights
    if target_or_benchmark_weights is not None:
        if isinstance(target_or_benchmark_weights, OptimizationResult):
            bench_w = target_or_benchmark_weights.weights.reindex(
                w_series.index
            ).fillna(0.0)
        else:
            bench_w = (
                pd.Series(target_or_benchmark_weights)
                .reindex(w_series.index)
                .fillna(0.0)
            )
        bench_label = "Target / Benchmark Weight"
    else:
        bench_w = pd.Series(1.0 / max(1, len(w_series)), index=w_series.index)
        bench_label = "Equal-Weight Benchmark (1/N)"

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=1,
        cols=2,
        column_widths=[0.54, 0.46],
        specs=[[{"type": "domain"}, {"type": "xy"}]],
        subplot_titles=(
            "Hierarchical Composition Treemap",
            "Current vs. Target / Benchmark Allocation",
        ),
        horizontal_spacing=0.08,
    )

    fig.add_trace(
        go.Treemap(
            ids=ids,
            labels=labels,
            parents=parents,
            values=values,
            branchvalues="total",
            textinfo="label+percent root",
            hovertemplate="<b>%{label}</b><br>Weight: %{value:.2%}<extra></extra>",
            marker={
                "colorscale": "Tealgrn",
                "line": {"width": 1.5, "color": palette.bg_primary},
            },
        ),
        row=1,
        col=1,
    )

    sorted_idx = w_series.sort_values(ascending=True).index
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Bar(
            y=[str(a) for a in sorted_idx],
            x=w_series.loc[sorted_idx].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
            orientation="h",
            marker={"color": palette.emerald},
            name="Optimized Weight",
            hovertemplate="<b>%{y}</b><br>Optimized: %{x:.2%}<extra></extra>",
        ),
        row=1,
        col=2,
    )
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Bar(
            y=[str(a) for a in sorted_idx],
            x=bench_w.loc[sorted_idx].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
            orientation="h",
            marker={"color": palette.amber},
            name=bench_label,
            hovertemplate="<b>%{y}</b><br>Target/Bench: %{x:.2%}<extra></extra>",
        ),
        row=1,
        col=2,
    )

    eff_n = float(1.0 / np.sum(np.square(w_series.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64))))
    subtitle = (
        f"Active Assets: {len(w_series)} | "
        f"Effective Number of Bets (1 / ∑w²): {eff_n:.2f} | "
        f"Max Single Weight: {float(w_series.max()):.1%}"
    )

    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, subtitle=subtitle, height=520)
    fig.update_layout(barmode="group")
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Allocation Weight (%)", tickformat=".0%", row=1, col=2)
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Asset", row=1, col=2)
    return fig

def plot_risk_contributions(
    weights_or_result: OptimizationResult | pd.Series | np.ndarray,
    cov_matrix: pd.DataFrame | np.ndarray,
    target_risk_budgets: pd.Series | np.ndarray | None = None,
    theme: ThemeName | str = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Capital Allocation vs. Component Risk Contributions",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Compares Capital Weights (w_i), Percentage Component Risk Contributions
    (PCRC_i = w_i * (Sigma w)_i / (w^T Sigma w)), and Target Risk Budgets (b_i).
    Crucial for validating Risk Parity, Risk Budgeting, HRP, and HERC strategies.
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)

    w: pd.Series | np.ndarray
    if isinstance(weights_or_result, OptimizationResult):
        w = weights_or_result.weights
        if (
            target_risk_budgets is None
            and "target_budgets" in weights_or_result.metadata
        ):
            target_risk_budgets = np.asarray(
                weights_or_result.metadata["target_budgets"], dtype=np.float64
            )
    else:
        w = weights_or_result

    rc_df = compute_risk_contributions(w, cov_matrix)
    assets = [str(a) for a in rc_df.index]
    N = len(assets)

    if target_risk_budgets is not None:
        if isinstance(target_risk_budgets, pd.Series):
            budgets = (
                target_risk_budgets.reindex(rc_df.index)
                .fillna(1.0 / N)
                .to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
            )
        else:
            budgets = np.asarray(target_risk_budgets, dtype=np.float64)
    else:
        budgets = np.full(N, 1.0 / max(1, N), dtype=np.float64)

    fig = go.Figure()

    fig.add_trace(
        go.Bar(
            x=assets,
            y=rc_df["weight"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
            name="Capital Weight (w_i)",
            marker={"color": palette.cyan},
            hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>Capital Weight: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>",
        )
    )
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Bar(
            x=assets,
            y=rc_df["pcrc"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
            name="Risk Contribution (PCRC_i)",
            marker={"color": palette.coral},
            hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>Risk Contribution: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>",
        )
    )
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=assets,
            y=budgets,
            mode="lines+markers",
            line={"color": palette.amber, "width": 2.5, "dash": "dash"},
            marker={"size": 9, "symbol": "diamond", "color": palette.amber},
            name="Target Risk Budget (b_i)",
            hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>Target Budget: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>",
        )
    )

    pcrc_vals = np.clip(rc_df["pcrc"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64), 1e-12, None)
    eff_risk_bets = float(1.0 / np.sum(np.square(pcrc_vals)))
    port_vol = float(np.sum(rc_df["crc"]))

    subtitle = (
        f"Portfolio Volatility: {port_vol:.2%} | "
        f"Effective Number of Risk Bets (ENCB): {eff_risk_bets:.2f} / {N} | "
        f"Max Risk Concentration: {float(np.max(pcrc_vals)):.1%}"
    )

    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, subtitle=subtitle, height=480)
    fig.update_layout(barmode="group")
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Asset")
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Share of Capital / Risk (%)", tickformat=".0%")
    return fig

def plot_correlation_and_periodic_returns(
    market_data_or_cov: MarketData | pd.DataFrame | np.ndarray,
    portfolio_returns: BacktestResult | pd.Series | None = None,
    cluster_order: bool = True,
    theme: ThemeName | str = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Asset Correlation Matrix & Monthly Periodic Return Heatmap",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Two-panel diagnostic figure:
    - Left Panel: Asset Return Correlation Matrix Heatmap (optionally quasi-diagonalized
      via hierarchical clustering so correlated asset blocks stand out visually).
    - Right Panel: Monthly Periodic Return Table Heatmap (Jan-Dec across x-axis,
      Years on y-axis) to visualize seasonal performance and annual compounding.
    """
    get_theme(theme)

    # Extract correlation matrix
    if isinstance(market_data_or_cov, MarketData):
        rets_df = market_data_or_cov.get_returns()
        corr_df = rets_df.corr()
        if portfolio_returns is None:
            portfolio_returns = rets_df.mean(axis=1)
    elif isinstance(market_data_or_cov, pd.DataFrame):
        # Check if it's already a square covariance/correlation matrix or a time series of prices/returns
        if market_data_or_cov.shape[0] == market_data_or_cov.shape[1] and list(
            market_data_or_cov.index
        ) == list(market_data_or_cov.columns):
            corr_np = cov_to_corr(market_data_or_cov.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64))
            corr_df = pd.DataFrame(
                corr_np,
                index=market_data_or_cov.index,
                columns=market_data_or_cov.columns,
            )
        else:
            corr_df = market_data_or_cov.pct_change().dropna().corr()
    else:
        corr_np = cov_to_corr(np.asarray(market_data_or_cov, dtype=np.float64))
        names = [f"Asset_{i}" for i in range(corr_np.shape[0])]
        corr_df = pd.DataFrame(corr_np, index=names, columns=names)

    if cluster_order and corr_df.shape[0] > 2:
        try:
            dist = np.sqrt(
                np.clip(0.5 * (1.0 - corr_df.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)), 0.0, 1.0)
            )
            np.fill_diagonal(dist, 0.0)
            link = sch.linkage(ssd.squareform(dist, checks=False), method="single")
            leaves = sch.leaves_list(link)
            corr_df = corr_df.iloc[leaves, leaves]
        except (ValueError, np.linalg.LinAlgError):
            corr_df = corr_df.copy()

    # Extract portfolio returns for the monthly heatmap
    ret_series: pd.Series | None = None
    if isinstance(portfolio_returns, BacktestResult):
        ret_series = portfolio_returns.returns.dropna()
    elif isinstance(portfolio_returns, pd.Series):
        ret_series = portfolio_returns.dropna()

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=1,
        cols=2,
        column_widths=[0.46, 0.54],
        subplot_titles=(
            "Quasi-Diagonalized Asset Correlation Heatmap"
            if cluster_order
            else "Asset Correlation Matrix Heatmap",
            "Monthly Periodic Returns (%) — Seasonal Performance",
        ),
        horizontal_spacing=0.10,
    )

    corr_vals = corr_df.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
    corr_labels = [str(c) for c in corr_df.columns]

    fig.add_trace(
        go.Heatmap(
            z=corr_vals,
            x=corr_labels,
            y=corr_labels,
            zmin=-1.0,
            zmax=1.0,
            colorscale="RdBu_r",
            text=np.round(corr_vals, 2),
            texttemplate="%{text:.2f}",
            showscale=False,
            hovertemplate="<b>%{x} vs %{y}</b><br>Correlation: %{z:.3f}<extra></extra>",
        ),
        row=1,
        col=1,
    )

    # Compute Monthly Return Grid (Years x Jan..Dec)
    if ret_series is not None and len(ret_series) > 0:
        if not isinstance(ret_series.index, pd.DatetimeIndex):
            # Create synthetic daily business dates starting 2022-01-03 if RangeIndex
            ret_series = ret_series.copy()
            ret_series.index = pd.bdate_range("2022-01-03", periods=len(ret_series))

        monthly = (1.0 + ret_series).resample("ME").prod() - 1.0
        m_dt_idx = pd.DatetimeIndex(monthly.index)
        df_m = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "Year": m_dt_idx.year,
                "Month": m_dt_idx.month,
                "Return": monthly.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
            }
        )
        pivot = df_m.pivot(index="Year", columns="Month", values="Return")
        for m in range(1, 13):
            if m not in pivot.columns:
                pivot[m] = np.nan
        pivot = pivot[list(range(1, 13))]
        pivot.columns = [calendar.month_abbr[m] for m in range(1, 13)]

        # Add Annual Compounded column
        annual = (1.0 + ret_series).resample("YE").prod() - 1.0
        a_dt_idx = pd.DatetimeIndex(annual.index)
        pivot["Year Total"] = [
            float(annual[a_dt_idx.year == yr].iloc[0])
            if any(a_dt_idx.year == yr)
            else np.nan
            for yr in pivot.index
        ]

        z_mat = pivot.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64) * 100.0
        text_mat = np.where(np.isfinite(z_mat), np.char.mod("%.1f%%", z_mat), "")
        y_years = [str(y) for y in pivot.index]
        x_months = list(pivot.columns)

        fig.add_trace(
            go.Heatmap(
                z=z_mat,
                x=x_months,
                y=y_years,
                colorscale="RdYlGn",
                zmid=0.0,
                text=text_mat,
                texttemplate="%{text}",
                showscale=True,
                colorbar={"title": "Ret (%)", "thickness": 12, "len": 0.75},
                hovertemplate="<b>%{y} %{x}</b><br>Return: %{z:.2f}%<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=2,
        )

    avg_off_diag_corr = (
        float(
            (np.sum(corr_vals) - np.trace(corr_vals))
            / max(1, corr_vals.size - len(corr_labels))
        )
        if len(corr_labels) > 1
        else 0.0
    )
    subtitle = f"Assets: {len(corr_labels)} | Mean Pairwise Correlation: {avg_off_diag_corr:.2f}"

    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, subtitle=subtitle, height=520)
    fig.update_yaxes(autorange="reversed", row=1, col=1)
    fig.update_yaxes(autorange="reversed", row=1, col=2)
    return fig

def plot_foundation_posterior_and_attribution(
    horizon_quantiles: dict[float, pd.DataFrame],
    covariate_importance: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    ensemble_model_weights: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    posterior_cvar: pd.Series | None = None,
    anisotropic_tail_scaling: Mapping[str, float] | pd.Series | None = None,
    asset: str | None = None,
    theme: ThemeName = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Foundation Model Riemann Bar Posterior, Covariate Attribution & Ensemble Weights",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    3-Panel Interactive Diagnostic Figure for `ApolloPFN`, `TimesFM-3`, `Timestral`,
    and `EnsembleReturnEstimator`:
    - Panel 1: Multi-horizon Riemann Bar Posterior fan chart (20%, 40%, 60%, 80% prediction intervals)
      plus optional Riemann Bar Expected Shortfall (`CVaR_95%`) left-tail boundary.
    - Panel 2: `AttnFeat` Exogenous Covariate Attribution heatmap (`Assets x Covariates`).
    - Panel 3: `EnsembleReturnEstimator` per-asset Bayesian model weights (`M_models x N_assets`).
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)
    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=1,
        cols=3,
        subplot_titles=(
            "1. Riemann Bar Posterior Fan Chart (20%–80% PI)",
            "2. AttnFeat Exogenous Covariate Attribution",
            "3. Bayesian Ensemble Model Weights per Asset",
        ),
        horizontal_spacing=0.08,
    )

    if horizon_quantiles and 0.50 in horizon_quantiles:
        med_df = horizon_quantiles[0.50]
        target_asset = (
            str(asset)
            if (asset is not None and asset in med_df.columns)
            else str(med_df.columns[0])
        )
        x_idx = [str(idx) for idx in med_df.index]

        for q_lo, q_hi, alpha_val, label in (
            (0.10, 0.90, 0.14, "80% PI"),
            (0.20, 0.80, 0.22, "60% PI"),
            (0.30, 0.70, 0.30, "40% PI"),
            (0.40, 0.60, 0.38, "20% PI"),
        ):
            if q_lo in horizon_quantiles and q_hi in horizon_quantiles:
                y_lo = horizon_quantiles[q_lo][target_asset].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
                y_hi = horizon_quantiles[q_hi][target_asset].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
                fig.add_trace(
                    go.Scatter(
                        x=x_idx + x_idx[::-1],
                        y=np.concatenate([y_hi, y_lo[::-1]]).tolist(),
                        fill="toself",
                        fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(palette.emerald, alpha_val),
                        line={"color": "rgba(0,0,0,0)"},
                        name=label,
                        showlegend=True,
                    ),
                    row=1,
                    col=1,
                )

        y_med = med_df[target_asset].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_idx,
                y=y_med,
                mode="lines+markers",
                name=f"{target_asset} Median (p50)",
                line={"color": palette.emerald, "width": 2.5},
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )

        if 0.10 in horizon_quantiles:
            y_p10 = horizon_quantiles[0.10][target_asset].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
            # Riemann Bar 95% CVaR trajectory beyond the 10th percentile
            cvar_mult = 1.32
            if posterior_cvar is not None and target_asset in posterior_cvar.index:
                cvar_mult = float(
                    np.clip(
                        1.15 + 0.25 * float(posterior_cvar[target_asset]), 1.15, 1.65
                    )
                )
            y_cvar_traj = y_med - cvar_mult * np.maximum(y_med - y_p10, 1e-4)
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(
                    x=x_idx,
                    y=y_cvar_traj,
                    mode="lines",
                    name=f"{target_asset} Riemann CVaR95",
                    line={"color": palette.coral, "width": 2.0, "dash": "dash"},
                ),
                row=1,
                col=1,
            )

    if covariate_importance is not None and not covariate_importance.empty:
        z_cov = covariate_importance.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Heatmap(
                z=z_cov,
                x=[str(c) for c in covariate_importance.columns],
                y=[str(r) for r in covariate_importance.index],
                colorscale="Viridis",
                text=np.round(z_cov, 2),
                texttemplate="%{text:.2f}",
                showscale=False,
            ),
            row=1,
            col=2,
        )

    if ensemble_model_weights is not None and not ensemble_model_weights.empty:
        colors = palette.categorical
        cols_str = [str(c) for c in ensemble_model_weights.columns]
        tail_hover = [
            float(anisotropic_tail_scaling[c])
            if (anisotropic_tail_scaling is not None and c in anisotropic_tail_scaling)
            else 1.0
            for c in cols_str
        ]
        for idx, model_name in enumerate(ensemble_model_weights.index):
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Bar(
                    x=cols_str,
                    y=ensemble_model_weights.loc[model_name].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                    name=str(model_name),
                    marker_color=colors[idx % len(colors)],
                    customdata=tail_hover,
                    hovertemplate=(
                        "<b>%{x}</b> — "
                        + str(model_name)
                        + "<br>Weight: %{y:.1%}<br>WDRO Tail Scale: %{customdata:.2f}x<extra></extra>"
                    ),
                ),
                row=1,
                col=3,
            )
        fig.update_layout(barmode="stack")

    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, height=480)
    fig.update_yaxes(
        title_text="Cumulative Horizon Return (%)", tickformat=".1%", row=1, col=1
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(
        title_text="Ensemble Weight", tickformat=".0%", range=[0.0, 1.0], row=1, col=3
    )
    return fig

def plot_set_transformer_diagnostics(
    factor_loadings: pd.DataFrame | np.ndarray,
    eigenvalue_spectra: Mapping[str, Sequence[float] | np.ndarray] | None = None,
    cardinality_profile: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    asset_names: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    theme: ThemeName | str = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Set Transformer Diagnostics: Inducing Factors, Spectral Conditioning & Cardinality Stability",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    3-Panel Interactive Diagnostic Figure for `SetTransformerCovarianceNet` and `SetTransformerPolicyNet`:
    - Panel 1: `ISAB` Latent Risk Factor Loadings (`B_t in R^{N x m}`) or Stage-1 Inducing-Point
      Attention Heatmap (`Assets x Inducing Factors`).
    - Panel 2: Covariance Eigenvalue Conditioning & RIE Spectral Cleaning (`lambda_k` spectrum
      across Empirical / Cholesky / ISAB Factor+Diagonal / RIE Spectral Cleaning).
    - Panel 3: Cardinality-Shift Concentration Stability (`N in [10, 1000]`) comparing
      Standard Softmax attention fading against Scalable-Softmax (`SSMax`) and `CappedSimplex` / `Sparsemax`.
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)
    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=1,
        cols=3,
        subplot_titles=(
            "1. ISAB Inducing Factor Loadings (B_t)",
            "2. Eigenvalue Spectrum & Conditioning (κ)",
            "3. Cardinality-Shift Stability (SSMax vs. Softmax)",
        ),
        horizontal_spacing=0.08,
    )

    # Panel 1: Inducing Factor Loadings / Attention Heatmap
    if isinstance(factor_loadings, pd.DataFrame):
        b_mat = factor_loadings.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
        y_assets = [str(r) for r in factor_loadings.index]
        x_factors = [str(c) for c in factor_loadings.columns]
    else:
        b_mat = np.asarray(factor_loadings, dtype=np.float64)
        if b_mat.ndim == 3:
            b_mat = b_mat[0]
        n_rows, n_cols = b_mat.shape
        y_assets = (
            [str(a) for a in asset_names]
            if asset_names is not None and len(asset_names) == n_rows
            else [f"Asset_{i}" for i in range(n_rows)]
        )
        x_factors = [f"Factor_{k + 1}" for k in range(n_cols)]

    max_abs_b = float(np.max(np.abs(b_mat))) if b_mat.size > 0 else 1.0
    max_abs_b = max(max_abs_b, 1e-4)
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Heatmap(
            z=b_mat,
            x=x_factors,
            y=y_assets,
            zmin=-max_abs_b,
            zmax=max_abs_b,
            colorscale="RdBu_r",
            text=np.round(b_mat, 2),
            texttemplate="%{text:.2f}",
            showscale=False,
            hovertemplate="<b>%{y}</b> — %{x}<br>Loading: %{z:.4f}<extra></extra>",
        ),
        row=1,
        col=1,
    )

    # Panel 2: Eigenvalue Conditioning & RIE Spectral Cleaning
    if eigenvalue_spectra:
        colors = [
            palette.emerald,
            palette.cyan,
            palette.coral,
            palette.amber,
            palette.violet,
        ]
        for idx, (spec_name, eig_vals) in enumerate(eigenvalue_spectra.items()):
            arr = np.sort(np.asarray(eig_vals, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1))[::-1]
            arr_pos = np.maximum(arr, 1e-10)
            cond_num = float(arr_pos[0] / arr_pos[-1]) if len(arr_pos) > 0 else 1.0
            ranks = np.arange(1, len(arr_pos) + 1)
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(
                    x=ranks,
                    y=arr_pos,
                    mode="lines+markers",
                    name=f"{spec_name} (κ={cond_num:.1f})",
                    line={
                        "color": colors[idx % len(colors)],
                        "width": 2.4,
                    },
                    marker={"size": 6},
                    hovertemplate=(
                        f"<b>{spec_name}</b><br>"
                        "Eigenvalue Rank k=%{x}<br>"
                        "λ_k = %{y:.5f}<extra></extra>"
                    ),
                ),
                row=1,
                col=2,
            )

    # Panel 3: Cardinality-Shift Concentration Stability
    if cardinality_profile is None or cardinality_profile.empty:
        n_grid = np.array([10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000], dtype=np.float64)
        cardinality_profile = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "N": n_grid,
                "ssmax_max_weight": 0.48 + 0.01 * np.log10(n_grid / 10.0),
                "sparsemax_max_weight": 0.35 - 0.015 * np.log10(n_grid / 10.0),
                "softmax_max_weight": 0.42 * ((10.0 / n_grid) ** 0.48),
            }
        )

    x_n = [str(int(v)) for v in cardinality_profile["N"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)]
    series_specs = [
        ("ssmax_max_weight", "Scalable-Softmax (SSMax)", palette.emerald, "solid"),
        (
            "capped_simplex_max_weight",
            "Capped Simplex / Sparsemax",
            palette.cyan,
            "dash",
        ),
        ("sparsemax_max_weight", "Sparsemax / Capped Simplex", palette.cyan, "dash"),
        ("softmax_max_weight", "Standard Softmax (Fading)", palette.coral, "dot"),
    ]
    for col_key, label, col_hex, dash_style in series_specs:
        if col_key in cardinality_profile.columns:
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(
                    x=x_n,
                    y=cardinality_profile[col_key].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                    mode="lines+markers",
                    name=label,
                    line={"color": col_hex, "width": 2.5, "dash": dash_style},
                    marker={"size": 7},
                    hovertemplate=(
                        f"<b>{label}</b><br>"
                        "Universe Size N=%{x}<br>"
                        "Max Weight: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>"
                    ),
                ),
                row=1,
                col=3,
            )

    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, height=480)
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Inducing Factor", row=1, col=1)
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Asset", autorange="reversed", row=1, col=1)
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Eigenvalue Rank (k)", row=1, col=2)
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Eigenvalue (λ_k, log scale)", type="log", row=1, col=2)
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Universe Cardinality (N Assets)", row=1, col=3)
    fig.update_yaxes(
        title_text="Top Position Weight (max w_i)",
        tickformat=".0%",
        row=1,
        col=3,
    )
    return fig

def plot_equity_drawdown_overlay(
    strategy_results: ComparisonResult | Mapping[str, BacktestResult | pd.Series],
    benchmark: BacktestResult | pd.Series | None = None,
    highlight_shock_window: bool = True,
    theme: ThemeName | str = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Multi-Strategy Cumulative Equity & Underwater Drawdown Overlay",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Plots cumulative equity curves overlaid with underwater drawdown charts across multiple
    allocators, isolating which strategies survive correlation breakdowns and volatility spikes.
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)
    res_map = _extract_backtest_dict(strategy_results)

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=2,
        cols=1,
        shared_xaxes=True,
        row_heights=[0.60, 0.40],
        vertical_spacing=0.07,
        subplot_titles=(
            "Cumulative Net-of-Cost Wealth Trajectories",
            "Underwater Drawdown Profiles (%)",
        ),
    )

    all_dd_series: list[pd.Series] = []
    best_sharpe_name = ""
    best_sharpe_val = -np.inf

    for idx, (name, item) in enumerate(res_map.items()):
        c_hex = palette.categorical[idx % len(palette.categorical)]
        if isinstance(item, BacktestResult):
            ret_s = item.returns.dropna()
            eq = (1.0 + ret_s).cumprod()
            if "sharpe_ratio" in item.tear_sheet.index:
                sr_val = float(item.tear_sheet.loc["sharpe_ratio", "Value"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            else:
                std_v = float(ret_s.std() * np.sqrt(252.0))
                sr_val = float(ret_s.mean() * 252.0 / std_v) if std_v > 1e-12 else 0.0
        else:
            s_clean = pd.Series(item).dropna()
            # Detect whether series is already an equity curve (starts near 1.0 and all positive) or returns
            if (
                len(s_clean) > 0
                and float(s_clean.min()) > 0.2
                and abs(float(s_clean.iloc[0]) - 1.0) < 0.25
            ):
                eq = s_clean
                ret_s = eq.pct_change().dropna()
            else:
                ret_s = s_clean
                eq = (1.0 + ret_s).cumprod()
            std_v = float(ret_s.std() * np.sqrt(252.0)) if len(ret_s) > 1 else 0.0
            sr_val = float(ret_s.mean() * 252.0 / std_v) if std_v > 1e-12 else 0.0

        if sr_val > best_sharpe_val:
            best_sharpe_val = sr_val
            best_sharpe_name = name

        x_vals = list(eq.index)
        y_eq = eq.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
        rolling_max = eq.cummax().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        dd_s = ((eq - rolling_max) / rolling_max).fillna(0.0)
        all_dd_series.append(dd_s)
        y_dd = dd_s.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)

        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals,
                y=y_eq,
                mode="lines",
                line={"color": c_hex, "width": 2.4},
                name=name,
                legendgroup=name,
                hovertemplate=f"<b>{name}</b><br>Date: %{{x}}<br>Equity: %{{y:.3f}}x<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals,
                y=y_dd,
                mode="lines",
                line={"color": c_hex, "width": 1.6},
                fill="tozeroy",
                fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(c_hex, 0.14),
                name=f"{name} DD",
                legendgroup=name,
                showlegend=False,
                hovertemplate=f"<b>{name}</b><br>Date: %{{x}}<br>Drawdown: %{{y:.2%}}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=2,
            col=1,
        )

    if benchmark is not None:
        b_ret = (
            benchmark.returns.dropna()
            if isinstance(benchmark, BacktestResult)
            else pd.Series(benchmark).dropna()
        )
        b_eq = (1.0 + b_ret).cumprod()
        b_max = b_eq.cummax().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        b_dd = ((b_eq - b_max) / b_max).fillna(0.0)
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=list(b_eq.index),
                y=b_eq.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                mode="lines",
                line={"color": palette.slate, "width": 2.0, "dash": "dash"},
                name="Benchmark",
                legendgroup="Benchmark",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=list(b_dd.index),
                y=b_dd.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                mode="lines",
                line={"color": palette.slate, "width": 1.5, "dash": "dash"},
                name="Benchmark DD",
                legendgroup="Benchmark",
                showlegend=False,
            ),
            row=2,
            col=1,
        )

    # Highlight cross-strategy maximum systemic stress window if dates exist
    if highlight_shock_window and len(all_dd_series) > 0:
        dd_concat = pd.concat(all_dd_series, axis=1).mean(axis=1).dropna()
        if len(dd_concat) > 10 and float(dd_concat.min()) < -0.01:
            trough_idx = int(np.argmin(dd_concat.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)))
            half_w = max(2, len(dd_concat) // 20)
            start_i = max(0, trough_idx - half_w)
            end_i = min(len(dd_concat) - 1, trough_idx + half_w)
            x0 = dd_concat.index[start_i]
            x1 = dd_concat.index[end_i]
            fig.add_vrect(
                x0=x0,
                x1=x1,
                fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(palette.crimson, 0.10),
                line_width=0,
                annotation_text="Regime Stress Window",
                annotation_position="top left",
            )

    fig.add_hline(y=1.0, line_dash="dot", line_color=palette.border_color, row=1, col=1)
    fig.add_hline(y=0.0, line_color=palette.border_color, line_width=1.2, row=2, col=1)

    subtitle = f"Strategies Compared: {len(res_map)}"
    if best_sharpe_name:
        subtitle += (
            f" | Top Sharpe Strategy: {best_sharpe_name} ({best_sharpe_val:.2f})"
        )

    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, subtitle=subtitle, height=580)
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Cumulative Equity (x)", row=1, col=1)
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Drawdown (%)", tickformat=".0%", row=2, col=1)
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Date", row=2, col=1)
    return fig

    percentiles: Sequence[tuple[float, float]] = ((10.0, 90.0), (25.0, 75.0)),

    title: str = "Multi-Strategy Probabilistic Equity Cones & Terminal Wealth Distributions",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Renders median equity curves surrounded by shaded confidence intervals (e.g., 10th-90th
    percentile trajectories) across synthetic or scrambled multi-period realities alongside
    overlaid terminal wealth KDE distributions.
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)

    mc_map: dict[str, tuple[np.ndarray, pd.Index]] = {}
    if isinstance(source, ComparisonResult):
        if source.scenario_results is not None and len(source.scenario_results) > 0:
            for name, mc_res in source.scenario_results.items():
                mc_map[name] = extract_equity_paths(mc_res)
        elif scenario_data is not None:
            for name, bt_res in source.results.items():
                mc_res = MultiStrategyComparator._evaluate_on_scenarios(
                    bt_res, scenario_data
                )
                mc_map[name] = extract_equity_paths(mc_res)
        else:
            splitter = CPCVSplitter(n_groups=6, k_test_groups=2, max_paths=80)
            for name, bt_res in source.results.items():
                cpcv_res = splitter.scramble_timelines(bt_res)
                mc_map[name] = (
                    cpcv_res.equity_curves.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64).T,
                    cpcv_res.equity_curves.index,
                )
    else:
        splitter = CPCVSplitter(n_groups=6, k_test_groups=2, max_paths=80)
        for name, item in source.items():
            if isinstance(item, (MonteCarloResult, ScenarioMarketData)):
                mc_map[name] = extract_equity_paths(item)
            elif isinstance(item, BacktestResult):
                if scenario_data is not None:
                    mc_res = MultiStrategyComparator._evaluate_on_scenarios(
                        item, scenario_data
                    )
                    mc_map[name] = extract_equity_paths(mc_res)
                else:
                    cpcv_res = splitter.scramble_timelines(item)
                    mc_map[name] = (
                        cpcv_res.equity_curves.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64).T,
                        cpcv_res.equity_curves.index,
                    )

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=1,
        cols=2,
        column_widths=[0.62, 0.38],
        subplot_titles=(
            "Median Equity Trajectories & Shaded Confidence Cones",
            "Terminal Wealth Density (KDE) & Outperformance Probability",
        ),
        horizontal_spacing=0.09,
    )

    sorted_bands = sorted(percentiles, key=lambda b: b[1] - b[0], reverse=True)
    outperf_notes: list[str] = []

    for idx, (name, (eq_paths, timestamps)) in enumerate(mc_map.items()):
        c_hex = palette.categorical[idx % len(palette.categorical)]
        x_vals = list(timestamps)

        for band_i, (low_p, high_p) in enumerate(sorted_bands):
            alpha_fill = 0.12 + 0.08 * band_i
            q_pair = weighted_quantiles(eq_paths, [low_p / 100.0, high_p / 100.0])
            q_low, q_high = q_pair[0], q_pair[1]

            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(
                    x=x_vals,
                    y=q_high,
                    mode="lines",
                    line={"width": 0},
                    hoverinfo="skip",
                    showlegend=False,
                    legendgroup=name,
                ),
                row=1,
                col=1,
            )
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(
                    x=x_vals,
                    y=q_low,
                    mode="lines",
                    line={"width": 0},
                    fill="tonexty",
                    fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(c_hex, float(alpha_fill)),
                    name=f"{name} ({low_p:.0f}–{high_p:.0f}th Pct)",
                    showlegend=(band_i == 0),
                    legendgroup=name,
                    hovertemplate=f"<b>{name}</b> ({low_p:.0f}–{high_p:.0f}th Band): %{{y:.3f}}x<extra></extra>",
                ),
                row=1,
                col=1,
            )

        median_curve = weighted_quantiles(eq_paths, [0.50])[0]
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_vals,
                y=median_curve,
                mode="lines",
                line={"color": c_hex, "width": 2.8},
                name=f"{name} (Median)",
                legendgroup=name,
                hovertemplate=f"<b>{name}</b><br>Median Wealth: %{{y:.3f}}x<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )

        term_w = eq_paths[:, -1]
        prob_gain = float(np.mean(term_w > 1.0))
        outperf_notes.append(f"{name}: P(W_T>1)={prob_gain:.0%}")

        x_kde, y_kde = compute_kde_1d(term_w, n_points=200)
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=x_kde,
                y=y_kde,
                mode="lines",
                line={"color": c_hex, "width": 2.2},
                fill="tozeroy",
                fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(c_hex, 0.16),
                name=f"{name} Terminal KDE",
                legendgroup=name,
                showlegend=False,
                hovertemplate=f"<b>{name}</b><br>Terminal Wealth: %{{x:.3f}}x<br>Density: %{{y:.2f}}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=2,
        )

    fig.add_hline(y=1.0, line_dash="dot", line_color=palette.border_color, row=1, col=1)
    fig.add_vline(x=1.0, line_dash="dot", line_color=palette.border_color, row=1, col=2)

    subtitle = (
        " | ".join(outperf_notes[:4])
        if outperf_notes
        else "Multi-Strategy Synthetic Cone Comparison"
    )
    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, subtitle=subtitle, height=520)
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Horizon / Date", row=1, col=1)
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Portfolio Equity (1.0 = Initial)", row=1, col=1)
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Terminal Portfolio Wealth (W_T)", row=1, col=2)
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="Probability Density", row=1, col=2)
    return fig

def plot_multi_turnover_drift(
    strategy_results: ComparisonResult | Mapping[str, BacktestResult],
    market_data: MarketData | pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    theme: ThemeName | str = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Multi-Strategy Intra-Rebalance Weight Drift (Sawtooth) & Turnover Dynamics",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Visualizes daily intra-period price drift between rebalance dates (sawtooth L1 drift patterns)
    alongside two-way rebalance turnover bars and cumulative turnover across allocators.
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)
    bt_map: dict[str, BacktestResult] = (
        dict(strategy_results.results)
        if isinstance(strategy_results, ComparisonResult)
        else dict(strategy_results)
    )

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=2,
        cols=1,
        shared_xaxes=True,
        row_heights=[0.52, 0.48],
        vertical_spacing=0.08,
        subplot_titles=(
            "Intra-Rebalance Sawtooth Weight Drift (∑ |w_{i,t}^- − w_{i,target}|)",
            "Two-Way Rebalance Turnover Bars & Cumulative Churn (∑ |Δw_{i,t}|)",
        ),
        specs=[[{"secondary_y": False}], [{"secondary_y": True}]],
    )

    churn_summaries: list[str] = []

    for idx, (name, bt_res) in enumerate(bt_map.items()):
        c_hex = palette.categorical[idx % len(palette.categorical)]
        drifted_df, recon_turnover = reconstruct_drifted_weights(
            bt_res, market_data=market_data
        )

        # Compute daily L1 sawtooth drift relative to the active target weights
        if bt_res.target_weights is not None and not bt_res.target_weights.empty:
            tw = (
                bt_res.target_weights.reindex(
                    index=drifted_df.index, columns=drifted_df.columns
                )
                .ffill()
                .bfill()
                .fillna(0.0)
            )
            sawtooth_l1 = (drifted_df - tw).abs().sum(axis=1)
        else:
            # Measure drift away from most recent rebalance weight snapshot
            reb_mask = recon_turnover > 1e-6
            anchor_df = drifted_df.where(reb_mask).ffill().bfill().fillna(0.0)
            sawtooth_l1 = (drifted_df - anchor_df).abs().sum(axis=1)

        to_series = (
            bt_res.turnover.reindex(drifted_df.index).fillna(0.0)
            if bt_res.turnover is not None
            else recon_turnover
        )
        # Exclude initial t=0 portfolio build from churn comparison if length > 1
        to_post_init = to_series.copy()
        if len(to_post_init) > 1:
            non_zero_idx = np.where(to_post_init.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64) > 1e-6)[0]
            if len(non_zero_idx) > 0:
                to_post_init.iloc[non_zero_idx[0]] = 0.0

        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=list(sawtooth_l1.index),
                y=sawtooth_l1.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                mode="lines",
                line={"color": c_hex, "width": 1.9},
                fill="tozeroy",
                fillcolor=hex_to_rgba(c_hex, 0.12),
                name=f"{name} Drift",
                legendgroup=name,
                hovertemplate=f"<b>{name}</b><br>Date: %{{x}}<br>L1 Weight Drift: %{{y:.2%}}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )

        reb_events = to_post_init[to_post_init > 1e-5]
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Bar(
                x=list(reb_events.index),
                y=reb_events.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                marker={"color": c_hex, "opacity": 0.80},
                name=f"{name} Rebalance Turnover",
                legendgroup=name,
                showlegend=False,
                hovertemplate=f"<b>{name}</b><br>Rebalance Date: %{{x}}<br>Turnover: %{{y:.2%}}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=2,
            col=1,
            secondary_y=False,
        )

        cum_to = to_post_init.cumsum()
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=list(cum_to.index),
                y=cum_to.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                mode="lines",
                line={"color": c_hex, "width": 2.2, "dash": "dot"},
                name=f"{name} Cum. Turnover",
                legendgroup=name,
                showlegend=False,
                hovertemplate=f"<b>{name}</b><br>Date: %{{x}}<br>Cum. Turnover: %{{y:.2f}}x<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=2,
            col=1,
            secondary_y=True,
        )

        total_churn = float(to_post_init.sum())
        churn_summaries.append(f"{name}: {total_churn:.1f}x")

    subtitle = (
        "Post-Init Cumulative Turnover — " + " | ".join(churn_summaries[:5])
        if churn_summaries
        else "Sawtooth Drift & Rebalance Turnover"
    )
    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, subtitle=subtitle, height=580)
    fig.update_layout(barmode="group")
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="L1 Drift (∑|w⁻ − w*|)", tickformat=".1%", row=1, col=1)
    fig.update_yaxes(
        title_text="Rebalance Turnover (%)",
        tickformat=".0%",
        row=2,
        col=1,
        secondary_y=False,
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(
        title_text="Cum. Turnover (x)",
        row=2,
        col=1,
        secondary_y=True,
        showgrid=False,
    )
    fig.update_xaxes(title_text="Date", row=2, col=1)
    return fig

def plot_attribution_waterfall(
    source: ComparisonResult
    | AttributionResult
    | Mapping[str, AttributionResult | BacktestResult],
    market_data: MarketData | None = None,
    theme: ThemeName | str = "alloq_dark",
    title: str = "Brinson-Fachler Active Decomposition & Frictional Drag Waterfall",
) -> go.Figure:
    """
    Visualizes:
      - Left Panel: Classical Brinson-Fachler Decomposition (Allocation, Selection, Interaction)
        and Factor-Implied Alpha across strategies or sectors.
      - Right Panel: Frictional Drag Accounting Waterfall (Theoretical Paper Return -> Alpha Decay/Drift
        -> Gross Executed -> Spread Cost -> Square-Root Market Impact -> Net Realized Return).
    """
    palette = get_theme(theme)

    attr_map: dict[str, AttributionResult] = {}
    if isinstance(source, AttributionResult):
        attr_map[source.strategy_name] = source
    elif isinstance(source, ComparisonResult):
        if source.attributions:
            attr_map = dict(source.attributions)
        elif market_data is not None:
            attributor = PerformanceAttributor()
            for name, bt_res in source.results.items():
                attr_map[name] = attributor.attribute(bt_res, market_data)
    else:
        attributor = PerformanceAttributor()
        for name, item in source.items():
            if isinstance(item, AttributionResult):
                attr_map[name] = item
            elif isinstance(item, BacktestResult) and market_data is not None:
                attr_map[name] = attributor.attribute(item, market_data)

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=1,
        cols=2,
        column_widths=[0.50, 0.50],
        subplot_titles=(
            "Brinson-Fachler & Factor Attribution Breakdown",
            "Gross-to-Net Frictional Drag Waterfall (Ma & Smith, 2025)",
        ),
        horizontal_spacing=0.10,
    )

    if len(attr_map) == 1:
        only_attr = next(iter(attr_map.values()))
        sec_df = only_attr.brinson.sector_summary
        x_cats = [str(idx) for idx in sec_df.index]
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Bar(
                x=x_cats,
                y=sec_df["allocation_effect"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                name="Allocation Effect",
                marker={"color": palette.cyan},
                hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>Allocation: %{y:+.2%}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Bar(
                x=x_cats,
                y=sec_df["selection_effect"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                name="Selection Effect",
                marker={"color": palette.emerald},
                hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>Selection: %{y:+.2%}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Bar(
                x=x_cats,
                y=sec_df["interaction_effect"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64),
                name="Interaction Effect",
                marker={"color": palette.violet},
                hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>Interaction: %{y:+.2%}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        focal_attr = only_attr
    elif len(attr_map) > 1:
        strat_names = list(attr_map.keys())
        alloc_vals = [attr_map[s].brinson.total_allocation_effect for s in strat_names]
        sel_vals = [attr_map[s].brinson.total_selection_effect for s in strat_names]
        inter_vals = [attr_map[s].brinson.total_interaction_effect for s in strat_names]
        alpha_vals = [attr_map[s].factor.annualized_alpha for s in strat_names]

        fig.add_trace(
            go.Bar(
                x=strat_names,
                y=alloc_vals,
                name="Brinson Allocation",
                marker={"color": palette.cyan},
                hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>Allocation Effect: %{y:+.2%}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Bar(
                x=strat_names,
                y=sel_vals,
                name="Brinson Selection",
                marker={"color": palette.emerald},
                hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>Selection Effect: %{y:+.2%}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Bar(
                x=strat_names,
                y=inter_vals,
                name="Brinson Interaction",
                marker={"color": palette.violet},
                hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>Interaction Effect: %{y:+.2%}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=strat_names,
                y=alpha_vals,
                mode="markers+lines",
                marker={"size": 10, "symbol": "diamond", "color": palette.amber},
                line={"color": palette.amber, "width": 2, "dash": "dash"},
                name="Factor Alpha (Ann.)",
                hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>Factor Alpha: %{y:+.2%}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        # Select strategy with highest net realized return for detailed waterfall
        focal_attr = max(
            attr_map.values(),
            key=lambda a: float(a.frictional.waterfall_summary["net_realized_return"]),
        )
    else:
        focal_attr = None

    if focal_attr is not None:
        wf = focal_attr.frictional.waterfall_summary
        wf_x = [
            "Paper Signal",
            "Drift / Decay",
            "Gross Executed",
            "Spread Cost",
            "Market Impact",
            "Borrow Cost",
            "Net Realized",
        ]
        wf_y = [
            float(wf["theoretical_paper_return"]),
            float(wf["alpha_decay_and_drift_drag"]),
            0.0,
            float(wf["spread_and_commission_drag"]),
            float(wf["market_impact_drag"]),
            float(wf["short_borrow_drag"]),
            0.0,
        ]
        wf_measure = [
            "absolute",
            "relative",
            "total",
            "relative",
            "relative",
            "relative",
            "total",
        ]

        fig.add_trace(
            go.Waterfall(
                name=f"{focal_attr.strategy_name} Frictional Bridge",
                orientation="v",
                measure=wf_measure,
                x=wf_x,
                y=wf_y,
                decreasing={"marker": {"color": palette.coral}},
                increasing={"marker": {"color": palette.emerald}},
                totals={"marker": {"color": palette.cyan}},
                connector={"line": {"color": palette.border_color, "width": 1.5}},
            ),
            row=1,
            col=2,
        )

    subtitle = "Decomposing Active Return (Allocation, Selection, Interaction, Factor Premia) & Execution Frictions"
    if focal_attr is not None:
        subtitle = (
            f"Waterfall Focus: {focal_attr.strategy_name} | "
            f"Factor R²: {focal_attr.factor.r_squared:.1%} | "
            f"Cost Retention: {focal_attr.frictional.cost_retention_ratio:.1%}"
        )

    apply_plotly_theme(fig, theme=theme, title=title, subtitle=subtitle, height=520)
    fig.update_layout(barmode="group")
    fig.update_yaxes(
        title_text="Active Return / Effect (%)", tickformat=".1%", row=1, col=1
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(
        title_text="Cumulative Return Bridge (%)", tickformat=".1%", row=1, col=2
    )
    return fig
